response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer (15+ years) with solid full-stack and some high-scale backend experience, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this Principal-level role: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis. There is also little demonstration of IC6-level scope such as leading multi-team initiatives or architecting systems adopted across an organization; most roles are hands-on senior IC positions at small-to-mid-size companies.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
High-scale, low-latency systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Strong craftsmanship signals: TDD, open-source contributions, teaching, and developer tooling including AI-agent/MCP work
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth measurement experience evident anywhere in the resume
No demonstrated Principal-level scope: no multi-team initiatives, org-wide platforms, or formal technical leadership/mentorship track record
Limited data/statistics background; no telemetry or metrics infrastructure work mentioned

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering depth and scale experience
